svg.text: CatBoost — Ordered Target Statistics (leakage-free categorical encoding)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Greedy target encoding uses a row's OWN label. Ordered TS only looks at rows that came BEFORE it.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ✘ GREEDY TS — leaks the target

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: x̂ᵢ = ( Σ y over the whole category + a·P ) / ( count + a )

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If the category is a UNIQUE ID (appears once):

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: x̂ᵢ = ( yᵢ + a·P ) / ( 1 + a ) ⟹ it IS yᵢ

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⟹ 100% training accuracy, useless on test data.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This is target leakage / conditional shift.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ✔ ORDERED TS — borrowed from online learning

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. draw a random permutation σ (an artificial "arrival time")

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. for the row at position k, use ONLY rows j < k

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that share the same category

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: x̂ₖ = ( Σ_{j<k, xⱼ=xₖ} yⱼ + a·P ) / ( count_{j<k} + a )

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: row k's own yₖ is never used

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Early rows have little history → CatBoost averages several permutations.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Worked example — category "Delhi", a = 1, prior P = 0.5
